invariants.rationale: Method always returns a non-null List; an empty ArrayList is returned if there are no small files.
All elements added to the result are non-null SmallFile instances.
Only files smaller than the Parquet small file limit are included as SmallFile.
Each SmallFile in the result is associated with the given partitionPath.
If there is any result, then partitionPath must be non-null, because methods on partitionPath are called unconditionally.
